---
title: "M16 · Classical Machine Learning"
subtitle: "Data Science · 0 of 22 lessons ready"
---

**Prerequisites:** [M05 Mathematics for Data Science (R)](m05.qmd), [M08 NumPy, Pandas & Polars](m08.qmd) · **GPU:** none

| # | Lesson | Level | Status | What you learn |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :-: | :--- |
| 01 | ML Problem Framing | 🟢 Beginner | 🛠️ in progress | Problem definition, success metrics, and business alignment. |
| 02 | Gradient Descent & Optimization | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Optimization algorithms, learning rates, and convergence. |
| 03 | Linear Regression | 🟢 Beginner | 🛠️ in progress | Regression basics, least squares, and interpretation. |
| 04 | Logistic Regression | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Binary classification, odds, and probability calibration. |
| 05 | Distance Models (KNN) | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Instance-based learning, distance metrics, and KNN. |
| 06 | Support Vector Machines | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Margin maximization, kernels, and SVM workflows. |
| 07 | Naive Bayes | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Probabilistic classification and conditional independence. |
| 08 | Decision Trees | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Tree construction, splitting criteria, and interpretability. |
| 09 | Bias-Variance & Regularization | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Underfitting, overfitting, and generalization control. |
| 10 | Ensemble: Bagging | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Bootstrap aggregating and parallel ensemble methods. |
| 11 | Ensemble: Boosting | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Sequential ensemble building and gradient boosting. |
| 12 | Gradient Boosting Libraries (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 13 | Unsupervised: Clustering | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | K-means, hierarchical clustering, and cluster evaluation. |
| 14 | Unsupervised: Dimensionality | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | PCA, manifold learning, and dimensionality reduction. |
| 15 | Anomaly Detection (Isolation Forest & LOF) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 16 | Model Evaluation & Validation | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Cross-validation, metrics, and model selection. |
| 17 | Classification Metrics | 🟡 Intermediate | 🛠️ in progress | Precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, and threshold selection. |
| 18 | Multiclass and Multilabel | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Multi-class classification and multilabel strategies. |
| 19 | Probability Calibration | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | Calibration methods and reliability diagrams. |
| 20 | Conformal Prediction (MAPIE) |  | 🛠️ in progress |  |
| 21 | Building ML Pipelines | 🟠 Advanced | 🛠️ in progress | End-to-end pipeline design and reproducibility. |
